Industry Body Asks Finance Minister to Scrap LTCG Tax

Ahead of the Union Budget, the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry (FICCI) has urged Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to scrap the Long Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax on listed shares. The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) Chairman stated that the government is examining industry proposals regarding the rationalization of LTCG and Securities Transaction Tax (STT).
